Salt and black pepper, to taste
steps: Melt the butter in a skillet set to 200 degrees F. Add the onions. Place ⅓-inch-thickly sliced onions on top of the butter. Add liver. Sliced liver has to be taken out of its packing and placed on top of onions. Season. Add black pepper and salt to taste.

Heat the skillet to 350 degrees F and then cover it. For around 7 minutes, cook the liver and onions. Turn the livers over in the skillet, then sprinkle them with black pepper and salt. Replace the lid, lower the heat to 300 degrees F, and carry on cooking for another 30 minutes. or so.

In a big glass, whisk 1 cup milk and ⅓ cup all-purpose flour until smooth. To the skillet, add this mixture. Another batch of milk and flour has to be prepared and added to the skillet after being smoothed together. Swirl the gravy in the skillet at this point, slide the livers and onions to 1 side of the pan before sliding them back over. Feel free to add more milk to the gravy if it's too thick to achieve the appropriate consistency. Reduce heat, then simmer. Make your side dishes, such as mashed potatoes and spinach, at this time.

name: Chicken Liver Mousse with Muscadel Wine Jelly
description: This Belgian liver mousse with muscadel wine jelly recipe will make your day with its delightful taste. Serve warm with your favorite salad.
ingredients: Salt and white pepper, to taste
½ cup and 2 teaspoon fresh cream
1 loaf fresh farm bread, thickly sliced
steps: Drain the chicken livers in a strainer after rinsing them under cold running water. In a sizable frying pan, melt the butter over medium heat before sautéing the onion until translucent but not browned. Sauté for almost 1 minute after adding the garlic. When the chicken livers are cooked to your taste, add them to the pan along with the thyme and spices. After seasoning to taste, remove the pan from the heat and let the food cool.

When the mixture is cool, pour it into a blender along with the cream and process at high speed until silky smooth. Place the mousse in a serving dish, wrap it in plastic wrap, and refrigerate. Put the Gelatine leaves in a bowl and add water to cover them. In a suitable saucepan, mix the lemon juice and cloves with ⅔ cup muscadel wine and cook to a boil. Squeeze the Gelatine leaves to remove the water, then mix them with the spicy sauce until they are completely dissolved. Pour the mixture over the mousse after straining it and giving it time to cool. Chill.

The grapes must be sautéed in the remaining ⅓ cup muscadel wine until they begin to burst and the wine turns syrupy in a suitable skillet over medium to low heat. Thick slices of farm bread and sautéed grapes can be served alongside the mousse.

name: Turkey Cutlets with Liverwurst and Oyster Mushrooms
description: When you can’t think of anything to serve in the lunch or dinner, then this turkey cutlet recipe with liverwurst and oyster mushrooms will help you big time.
steps: Wash and dry the turkey cutlets before flattening them. On 1 side of each cutlet, spread liverwurst, then season the other half with black pepper and salt. Using toothpicks, cover the liverwurst with the seasoned cutlet halves. Fry the cutlets for almost 6 minutes on each side over medium heat after preheating the oil and butter in a pan.

Cut into strips after trimming the oyster mushrooms. Parsley has to be rinsed, dried off, and chopped roughly. Keep warm after removing the cutlets from the pan. Stirring frequently, sauté oyster mushrooms in pan drippings for almost 5 minutes. Add salt, pepper, and lemon juice for seasoning. Add the sour cream and parsley, then stir. Serve the cutlets with mushrooms.

name: Ostrich Fillet with Mushrooms and Beetroot Blocks
description: Here’s another classic recipe for your dinner or lunch recipe collection. Serve it with a tangy side salad and enjoy the best of it.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
1 ½ large onion, cut in quarters and parted
3 king oyster mushrooms, cut in 3x lengthwise
steps: Caramelize the onions in a pot with the oil and butter over medium heat for almost 10 minutes. Onions must possess that lovely honey color. Add the salt, pepper, and mushrooms along with the thyme and rosemary. Fry for almost 10 more minutes. Deglaze the pan by stirring in red wine and garlic. The tomato paste and chicken stock should then be added. Simmer until just half the mixture remains. It must have the consistency of a little thick sauce, which is crucial. Melt the remaining butter after adding it. Season and taste. Add the beetroot blocks after passing through a fine sieve. Place aside. The rosemary and thyme has to be thrown away, but save the large onion chunks and oyster mushrooms.

When the oil in the pan is hot, fry the ostrich to your preferred doneness. To your liking, season the meat. Fry the steak with the onions and mushrooms that you used in the jus. Remove the steak from the pan and let it rest for at least 8 minutes, before adding the red wine jus to the pan juices. Place the steak on a platter and top with a suitable oyster mushroom and some chopped onion. After that, add some jus to the plate's base. Around the steak, garnish with a few blocks of beetroot.

name: Roasted Asparagus and Mushrooms
description: Try these super tasty Belgian roasted asparagus and mushrooms for your meals, and you’ll never stop having it; that’s how heavenly the combination tastes.
steps: At 450 degrees F, preheat your oven. Place the mushrooms and asparagus in an equal layer on a baking sheet with a rim. Add salt, drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat. Allow about 15 minutes of roasting in the oven with periodic tossing until soft and mildly browned. Add thyme leaves and butter. Toss the asparagus and mushrooms in the butter once it has melted. Return to the oven and roast for almost 5 minutes. until just faintly glazed. Remove from the oven, then stand aside for a while. Add the watercress and mix. On a dish, arrange the roasted vegetables. Add a balsamic vinegar drizzle. To taste, add flaky sea salt to the dish.

name: Belgian Chicken with Juniper Berries
description: You can cook Belgian chicken with juniper berries for a nice serving. The chicken with soaked in garlic mixture butter, onion, and berries.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
steps: Use a lot of black pepper and salt to season. In a sizable, covered sauté pan set over medium-high heat, melt the butter and oil. Working in batches, brown the chicken for almost 3 to 4 minutes per side, until both sides are browned. Place on a platter. Add onion after lowering the heat to medium. Cook for almost 2 minutes, stirring nearly constantly until just softened. Cook the garlic for almost 45 seconds while stirring continuously. Return the chicken to the pan along with any fluids, lower the heat to low, and cook the chicken, covered, for almost 25 to 30 minutes., until thoroughly cooked. About halfway through, turn the chicken over and baste it with pan juices (use an instant-read thermometer to check sure the chicken has reached a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees F).

The juniper berries can also be crushed using the bottom of a heavy saucepan or a mortar and pestle. Chicken has to be flamed. Put the gin in a suitable pot and heat it until hot once the chicken is fully cooked. Then, carefully ignite the gin with a long match after turning off the heat (and your vent fan). Pour it over the chicken and let the alcohol burn out. If the flames grow too ferocious—which they didn't in our case—have a pan lid ready to cover the pan. Add 1 or 2 teaspoons of water, then sprinkle the juniper berries over the chicken, and flip the pieces over to fully coat them with the sauces and berries. Cook for almost 2 minutes, until the sauce has somewhat reduced. Place the chicken on a plate and top with the sauces. Serve.

name: Belgian Tomatoes Stuffed with Shrimp
description: These Belgian tomatoes stuffed with shrimp are one delicious and healthy entree, which has a refreshing taste due to the use of rich mayo filling.
ingredients: ⅛ lb. cooked shrimp, peeled, chopped
steps: Remove the tomato's center using a spoon. On a dish, arrange lettuce. In a bowl, place the tomato center. Mix lemon juice and shrimp. To taste, add lemon pepper. To bind, add just enough mayonnaise. Put in tomato.

name: Applesauce Barbecue Chicken
description: Applesauce Barbecue chicken is a special Belgian treat and it’s a great serving . Use this quick and simple recipe to get it ready in no time.
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (6 oz. each)
steps: Add some pepper to the chicken. Cook the chicken in oil on all sides in a big skillet. Pour over the chicken after combining the remaining ingredients in a suitable bowl. Cook for almost 7–10 minutes, with the lid on, until a thermometer registers 330 degrees F.

name: Pumpkin Risotto
description: Do you want to have some classic pumpkin risotto? If you haven’t tried it before, now is the time to cook this delicious serving at home using simple and healthy ingredients.
steps: If making your pumpkin puree, go to the directions by clicking the aforementioned link in the ingredient list. The vegetable broth has to be made and heated in a casserole. In a big, deep pan over medium temperature, pour the olive oil. The onions has to be diced and added to the hot pan, For a few minutes longer, sauté the onions until transparent.

To the pan, add the arborio rice. For approximately a minute, stir and continue to fry. Rice will start to seem transparent. While stirring, add the white wine and sage leaves. Cook the rice for a further few minutes over a suitable flame to incorporate the wine.

Turn off the flame. One ladle at a time, begin a gentle addition of the vegetable broth. Gently mix the rice between ladles until it has absorbed the majority of the broth. Keep using the ladles until the majority of the broth has been consumed (about 15 minutes.). Add one the ladle and the extra pumpkin liquid. The rice ought to have a delicate, slight stiffness.

Over a low temperature, add the pumpkin puree and gradually stir it into the rice. Butter, pecorino, and parmesan cheeses are added after taking the skillet off the heat. Stir them into the risotto slowly. As the cheese and butter melt into the risotto, cover the pan and set it aside for a few minutes. Use black pepper and salt to adjust the seasoning.

If additional sage is required, do so cautiously because a little bit goes a long way. Mushrooms must be sautéed in a little olive oil in a separate pan if you’re adding them. Place the mushrooms on top of the risotto before serving. While the risotto is still hot, serve and savor it!

name: Porcini Mushroom and Carrot with Gravy
description: Yes, you can make something as delicious as this gravy by using only few basic ingredients using some simple techniques.
steps: Rehydrate the mushrooms in warm water. Preheat the oil in a suitable pan. Sauté the onion in heated oil until it turns transparent. Over medium-high heat, add the carrot dice and sauté for almost 5 minutes. Use red wine to deglaze.

Cook for almost 5 minutes. at a medium-high temperature. Porcini mushrooms has to be drained and rinsed. The saucepan should now contain the vegetable stock, cashews, cloves, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Simmer for almost 20 minutes at medium heat. Apple-pear fruit syrup has to be added.
For an additional 2 minutes, simmer. Using a strong blender or a hand mixer, blend on high. If you want it thinner, add a little water or vegetable stock.

name: Vol Au Vent
description: Try these Vol au vent on the menu. The savory mix of chicken with cream cheese and bacon inside the puff pastry are blissful for all the foodies like me.
ingredients: 1 package (17 oz.) frozen puff pastry, thawed
steps: At 400 degrees F, preheat your oven. Open 1 sheet of puff pastry and place it on a lightly dusted board. Cut 6 circles with a 3-⅓-inch round cutter. Place on a baking sheet covered with parchment paper. The remaining pastry sheet is unfolded. With the 3-⅓" round cutter, make 6 more circles, and then use a 2-½" cutter to remove the centers.

On top of the circles on the baking sheet, place the rings. Additionally, put the middle circles on the baking sheet. Egg and water are beaten together in a small basin; brush on pastry. Relax for 15 minutes.

Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until deep golden brown. on a wire rack to cool. In the meantime, fry the bacon until crisp in a big skillet over medium heat. Drain after removing to paper towels. Keep only 1 tablespoon of the drippings. Add pepper and leeks to drippings; cook and stir over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes, or until the leeks are soft. Turn the heat down to low and mix in the cream cheese, bacon, and chicken. Cook and whisk until well combined; turn off the heat. Use a tiny knife to hollow out pastries after cold enough to handle. Place chicken mixture within. Add some pepper and parsley. Serve with a side of the little center pastries.

name: Rice Pudding (Riz Au Lait)
description: This Riz Au Lait will satisfy your pudding cravings in no time. It’s quick to make if you have all the following ingredients at home.
steps: in a suitable- to large-sized saucepan, mix the milk, rice, sugar, and salt. Heat while occasionally stirring until the mixture boils. Cook the rice, stirring regularly (to prevent it from clinging to the bottom and sides of the pot as well as to 1 another) until it’s almost cooked and most of the liquid has been absorbed about 20 to 25 minutes.

If used, stir in the vanilla paste and cook for a further 15 minutes. over very low heat, until the pudding mixture resembles very loose oatmeal and the rice grains are soft. When the heat is turned off, add the vanilla extract and, if used, the lemon or orange zest.

name: Rijstevlaai
description: Rijstevlaai will leave you amazed due to their mildly sweet taste and the combination of flour dough with rice and egg filling.
steps: We'll make the prepared dough first because it needs time to rise. Mix sugar, yeast, and flour together. Milk and butter are heated till lukewarm. The yeast won't function as well if the temperature is too high. The prepared dough has to be smooth and elastic after a few minutes. of kneading. Put the prepared dough ball in a bowl, wrap it in cling film, and place it in a warm area to rise for almost an hour.

Make the dessert rice in the meanwhile. Milk that has been heated with salt. Add the rice and quickly mix once the milk is warm. Rice should cook on low heat with the pan lid on. The type of dessert rice you use will determine the exact cooking time; the type we used required roughly 30 minutes. Allow the rice to gently cool. Butter and flour has to be spread on the pie pan. The rijstevlaai is completed in 30 minutes. Roll out the prepared dough to a very thin thickness after flouring the work surface and rolling the pin. Transfer the prepared dough to the form, trimming any extra, and pressing it with your hands to the bottom.

Use a fork to poke holes in the bottom, then allow the prepared dough to rise for a further 15 minutes. The oven has to be preheated to 450 degrees F, as these pies will soon bake in a very hot oven. Add the vanilla sugar to finish the filling in the meanwhile. We won't add anything to the pan because if we do, the rice would burn much more quickly.

To make the egg yolks frothy and pale, mix them with 1 ½ oz. of sugar. Add them to the filling mixture. Divide the filling into thirds and press the prepared dough down once more. Egg whites are gently added to ⅓ of the filling after being thoroughly whipped until firm peaks form. Depending on your oven, spread the fluffy filling evenly over the top of the pie and bake it for almost 10 minutes until it’s a lovely golden brown. Be careful not to open the oven door while the pie is baking or the pie will fall apart. Allow the pie to cool for almost 10 minutes inside the oven with the door slightly ajar. Let the pie cool down fully after that. Most people eat Rijstevlaais with whipped cream and chocolate shavings, but we thought it would be more interesting to show you the gorgeous golden brown top.

name: Mattentaart
description: The famous Belgian Mattentaart is another special dessert to try on the Belgian menu. Try baking it at home with these healthy ingredients and enjoy it.
steps: Bring the milk to a rapid boil in a big pot. Once it gets boiling, add the buttermilk and well whisk. The mixture will curdle as you stir it. After turning off the heat, line a fine sieve with two layers of cheesecloth or a dishtowel made of linen. As the sieve is positioned over a deep saucepan, the curd mixture has to be poured through it. At least 12 hours must be spent draining in a cool area.

Once the curds have drained, the egg yolks and whites has to be separated. With the egg whites, create firm peaks. The curds, egg yolks, almonds, and sugar must be mixed using an electric mixer or a food processor. Gently and evenly incorporate the egg whites into the mixture until everything is completely mixed. At 400 degrees F, preheat your oven. Butter your pan or cake pan. Cut the puff pastry to size, and line the bottom of the baking pan. Add the egg and curd mixture. Put the second puff pastry layer on top of the filling. Slice through the top pastry layer many times. Bake the tart for almost 50 minutes. After removing from the oven, allow cooling before serving.

name: Smoutebollen
description: The Smoutebollen have no parallel; these sugary flour balls with icing sugar on top make a nice serving with tea and coffee.
steps: Put the butter aside after it has melted. When the milk is lukewarm, remove it from the heat and whisk in the flour and yeast in that order. Warm the milk in a suitable saucepan over low heat. Place aside. Separate the whites from the yolk. Stirring until mixed, add the yolk, sugar, salt, and beer to the pan containing the flour. Whisk in the melted butter. Utilizing an electric mixer, whip the egg white until it becomes stiff snow.

In 2 to 3 batches, fold the meringue into the batter. The volume of the saucepan will double after 90 minutes. if it is kept warm and covered with a cloth. Fry the oil in a heavy-bottomed saucepan or fryer until it reaches 190 degrees F.

Fry 6 to 7 Smoutebollen at a time, for almost 1 minute on each side, using 2 tablespoons to scoop up a portion of the batter, form it into a ball, and carefully drop it into the oil. Use a slotted spoon to transfer them to a bowl lined with paper towels after evenly golden brown. The remaining batter must be fried in the same way, and after it is, sprinkle it with powdered sugar and serve it warm.

name: Belgian Sugar Pie
description: The Belgian sugar pie is great to serve with all the hot beverages, and it’s popular for its prominent sweet and earthy taste.
steps: Add brown sugar to a suitable saucepan. Stir in the cream, cinnamon, and 1 tablespoon of soft butter as well. Warm the cream mixture in the pan over medium heat until the brown sugar has completely dissolved. After that, turn off the heat and let the pan to completely cool. Add the egg once it has cooled. Mix thoroughly. Set aside the sugar filling for later. The dough is rolled out and coated with butter in a tart pan. At 437 degrees F, blind bake it for around 10 minutes.

After that, remove the pie pan from the oven and add the sugar filling. Reheat the oven and bake the sugar pie for an additional 30 minutes, or until the center is nearly set. Removing the pie from the oven a second time, immediately sprinkle it with more caster sugar. By grilling the sugar for a minute to caramelize it, you can let the sugar to melt on top. Serve.

name: Yogurt Cake with Apricot
description: The Belgian yogurt cake with apricot is famous for its delicious flavor and fluffy texture. Made out of mainly yogurt, sugar, and eggs, it goes well with a glass of smoothie.
steps: In a bowl, combine the egg yolks with the yogurt, sugar, and salt. Using a hand mixer, combine the flour and baking powder. While the mixture is being mixed, add the vegetable oil. Finally, using a spatula, fold in the dried fruits.

4 egg whites should be whisked until they form stiff peaks. With a hand mixer, combine the batter with ⅓ of the meringue, aerate the mixture, and then gently fold in the remaining meringue. Take cupcake mold, fill them with the mixture, and bake them for 20 minutes at 460 degrees F in a preheated oven.

name: Belgian Christmas Cake
description: The Belgian Christmas cake is worth the try as they taste so unique and exotic. This dessert is definitely a must on the Belgian menu.
steps: In the thermomix's bowl, mix the milk and the yeast. Mix at 100 degrees F for almost 2 minutes. at speed 2. Add the softened butter, whole egg, sugar, and flour. For 5 minutes., leave the ear function on. Give the prepared dough 1 hour to rise.

A 410 degrees F oven is to be used. Gently rework the prepared dough. After the cougnole, shape two balls with some of the prepared dough. Form the body out of the leftover dough. By gluing the 2 balls with a little water on either side, add them. Bake for almost 30 minutes after brushing with egg yolk. It’s best to eat the cougnole cold.

name: Ontbijtkoek
description: If you haven’t tried the Belgian Ontbijtkoek before, then here comes a simple and easy to cook a recipe that you can recreate at home in no time with minimum efforts.
steps: At 300 degrees F, preheat your oven. Butter and line a cake pan with parchment paper. Rye flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, and spices should all be mixed in the bowl of a stand mixer. Brown sugar, honey, molasses, vanilla essence, and hot milk should all be thoroughly blended in a big bowl.

Using the flat beater, gradually incorporate the liquid mixture into the dry mixture to create a smooth dough. The mixture has to be poured into a cake pan. Bake for 80 minutes. Cover the Ontbijtkoek top with two sheets of parchment paper if the baking causes the top to brown excessively. Allow the cake pan to cool for 5 minutes., then remove the mold, and let cool completely on a rack.

name: Speculoos Cookies
description: The famous Speculoos cookies are essential to try on the Belgian dessert menu. Try baking them at home with these healthy ingredients and enjoy with coffee or tea.
ingredients: 2 ⅓ cup firmly packed dark brown sugar
steps: Use the paddle attachment of your stand mixer (or an electric mixer) to beat the brown sugar, butter, egg yolks, cream, vanilla, and lemon zest until light and fluffy, about 5 to 6 minutes. Once mixed, add the almond/hazelnut flour. Mix the flour, salt, baker's ammonia, and spices in a different bowl. Gradually incorporate this flour mixture into the wet mixture while beating.

Add a little extra egg yolk, as necessary, if the prepared dough is too dry or crumbly. The prepared dough has to be formed into a ball, carefully wrapped in plastic wrap, and left to rest for at least five hours or overnight in a cold location (not the refrigerator or it will turn brittle). To a thickness of about ¼ inch or slightly less than ⅓ inch, roll out the prepared dough onto a lightly dusted work surface.

To shape the Speculoos, you can either use a knife to simply cut them into little rectangles , or you can use molds, cookie stamps, a molded rolling pin, or any other cookie cutters of your choice (see blog post pictures for instructions on how to use molds and molded rolling pins).

Molds must be lightly dusted with flour before use to avoid sticking. Cookies must be cut out and put on a non-stick baking sheet. Before baking, the cookies has to be chilled for at least an hour. At 375 degrees F, preheat your oven. The Speculoos has to be baked for almost 10 to 12 minutes. on the middle rack, until well browned, and caramelized.

The Speculoos should cool for a few minutes. before being moved to a wire rack to finish cooling. In an airtight container, keep them. To give the tastes time to meld, it’s advisable to wait at least a week before eating them. They’ll last for several weeks in an airtight container in a cool environment. Enjoy by the handfuls alone or dipped in your preferred hot beverage.

name: Liege Waffle
description: Liege waffles are one good option to go for in the desserts. You can also keep them ready and stored, then serve with chocolate dip.
steps: Warm milk in a stand mixer bowl is topped with yeast and sugar. Let stand for approximately 5 minutes. until yeast starts to foam. Add two eggs, and melted butter, and mix with a fork to mix. Add the yeast and milk mixture to the 3 cups of flour, salt, and vanilla. Use the dough hook and mix on low until the mixture is smooth. Mix on low for two minutes. after adding the final ½ cup of flour. Leave for 30 minutes. covered in a warm place. Use a big spoon or your hands to fold 8 oz. of Belgian pearl sugar into the prepared dough once it has risen. Cut the prepared dough into pieces that are about 3–4 oz. each. There has to be nine to ten dough balls.

The waffle iron has to be preheated for almost 10 minutes. before cooking the prepared dough. The waffle iron has to be generously greased with cooking spray. Cook 1 piece of dough at a time by placing it in the center of the waffle iron, covering it, and baking it until the exterior is crispy and the inside is thoroughly cooked. Using a waffle iron and the heat setting will affect how long it takes to cook. If sugar is heated at a temperature that’s too high, it’ll burn. While heating the remaining dough, place fried waffles on a wire rack. Serve immediately with toppings, or keep in a heated oven at 225 degrees F until ready to serve.

name: Belgi Galettes
description: Without these Belgi galettes; it seems like the Belgian dessert menu is incomplete. Try them with different variations of toppings and filling.
steps: Brown sugar and butter must be thoroughly mixed in a suitable bowl before adding the eggs and vanilla and beating until completely mixed. Stir in the flour gradually. Mixing the components in a bowl over a hot water bath requires stirring.

Overnight, cover and chill. Get the galette iron ready. Create dough balls the size of an inch and place them in the galette iron. Cook the cookies and then shut off the iron. In an electric galette iron, this should take around 30 seconds or 2 to 4 minutes. in a portable iron over medium heat. Remove cookies with care, then let them cool on wire racks.

name: Couque De Dinant
description: Here comes a dessert that’s most loved by all. The Couque de dinants aren’t only served as a dessert, but they’re also famous street food.
steps: Add 5 oz. of honey to a suitable pot and heat slowly over low heat until it becomes very liquid but does not boil. In a big bowl, mix the honey and 7 oz. of flour. Use a spatula to mix, then briefly knead the prepared dough with your hands to ensure uniformity. Honey makes things a little sticky, but if you spread it out, it shouldn't crack. Add a little honey if the prepared dough is too dry, and some flour if it’s too sticky. Roll out the prepared dough to a thickness of 5 mm after flouring the work surface and dough's surface. If you have a wooden Couque or Speculoos mold, cut the prepared dough to fit the mold's measurements, lightly dust the mold, then put the prepared dough inside.

Next, push down firmly on the prepared dough's surface with your fingertips or the heel of your hand to imprint the design. Unmold. Use a suitable cookie cutter to cut out the desired shapes if you don't have a mold. Pre-heat the oven to its highest setting, ideally 300 degrees F cup The Couque has to be cooked for almost 10 minutes. while being attentively watched. The edges has to be somewhat burned or golden brown.

When the cookies are still very hot from the oven, immediately coat them with a pastry brush dipped in water, then set them aside to cool. As the cookies cool, they will become extremely hard, and the next day they’ll become even tougher. Break a piece from the table edge and place it in your mouth, letting it melt, to taste them. Couque de dinant will remain fresh for several months if kept in an airtight container.

name: Belgian Beer Sangria
description: Beat the heat and try the famous Belgian beer sangria prepared using the mixture of cranberry juice, white wine, and cherries. The combination is super refreshing and healthy.
ingredients: 1 pint of fresh cherries, pitted and halved
1 bottle of your favorite white wine
steps: Add the sugar and the water to a suitable saucepan and simmer over medium-low heat until all of the sugar is dissolved (about 5 minutes.). Place in a container and let cool. Pour wine into a sizable pitcher, add fruit, and chill for almost 30 minutes. Add the sugar and the water mixture (simple syrup) beer, and then stir. Pour over ice in serving glasses. Fill each glass with a suitable amount of cranberry juice. Refrigerate for up to 2 days, if not in use.

name: Belgian Caipirinha
description: The Belgian Caipirinha cocktail is beloved due to its refreshing taste and sweet flavors. Serve chilled for best taste.
steps: Squeeze and add a few lime wedges to a big glass. To the glass, add the crushed pearl sugar. Belgian sugar pearls can also be added to the glass, then everything can be muddled together. Try using the wooden spoon handle as a muddler if you don't have one. Cachaça has to be added, along with some ice. Nice stirring.

name: Belgian Coffee
description: The Belgian coffee is great to serve on all the special occasions and dinner. It has this appealing d’anvers flavor.
steps: Add the coffee, liquor, and sugar to taste in an Irish coffee cup. Sprinkle the grated chocolate on top after gently floating the cream on top.

name: Bloody Orange Belgian Cocktail
description: The Bloodied Belgian cocktail is famous for its blend of scotch whisky, vermouth, orange juice, Flemish sour ale, and cherries. You can prep this drink easily at home.
ingredients: 4 oz. Flemish sour ale or kriek Lambic
steps: Ice cubes should fill a cocktail shaker about halfway. Shake well after adding the scotch, vermouth, and blood orange juice. Into a cocktail glass, strain. Add the ale on top, garnish with the cherries, and then serve.

name: Green Devil
description: The green devil cocktail is made from gin, absinthe, and duvel and it makes a great serving when chilled.
steps: Pour the absinthe inside a beer glass, particularly one designed for Belgian brews. Aim for a good, frothy head when adding the gin and lager.
